checklist: Show a work in progress (WIP) to at least one other person, for example another learner or a friend, and ask one specific question about it. Any small piece of Unreal Engine work of your own is fine, such as a room made of cubes.
Write down the feedback you got. Then write your reply to it: say what you will change, or why you will not change it. Paste your question, the feedback and your reply as your proof.
